name: pl-vat-return
description: Pointer: Polish VAT returns for tax year 2026 are covered in poland-vat-return. Use poland-vat-return for registration (VAT-R), the 23%, 8%, 5% and 0% rates, the PLN 240,000 small-business exemption and the EU SME scheme, the JPK_V7M and JPK_V7K files due on the 25th, KSeF e-invoicing from 1 February and 1 April 2026, split payment above PLN 15,000, the white list, reverse charge, the 30% additional liability and 10.50% late interest. Trigger on: Polish VAT return, JPK_V7M, JPK_V7K, deklaracja VAT, plik JPK.
